audit_phase: Phase 2B Chrome Runtime Transport Hotfix Build

runtime_transport_hotfix.problem_statement: The unpacked Chrome extension had a dead Electron/main-process window.postMessage bridge (xpiderInvoke), causing a 30-second timeout on START SENDING in real Chrome (IPC timeout: xpider-campaign-start).
runtime_transport_hotfix.resolution_architecture: Completely eliminated dead native IPC calls in Chrome operator workflows, routing all campaign start, control, state retrieval, and configuration directly through the Chrome Background Service Worker (background.js) and chrome.downloads API.

dead_channels_eliminated.replacement: chrome.runtime.sendMessage({ action: 'START_CAMPAIGN', queue, template, ... }) with ACK verification
chrome.runtime.sendMessage({ action: 'GET_STATE' }) directly on popup load

runtime_transport_hotfix.qa_status: AUTOMATED SUITE = PASS (74/74); LIVE EXTENSION RUN = PENDING OWNER VERIFICATION IN REAL CHROME

verification_tests: DIAG-IPC-1: No Responder Path — Rejection, Checkpoints, and Structured Diagnostic Dump
DIAG-IPC-2: Responder Present Path — ID Match, Latency Capture, and Clean Resolution
TC-2B-11: Privacy-Safe Redaction Engine & User Diagnostic Controls
ipc_diagnostic_patch.privacy_redaction: Automatic redaction of emails, phone numbers, auth tokens/secrets, full URL lists
ipc_diagnostic_patch.qa_status: Diagnostic and redaction subsystem verified; active engine logs [Engine][TX], [Engine][ACK], [Engine][VERIFY]

R1_MANDATE_1_PAYLOAD_BINDING.description: startCampaign() explicitly calls bindCampaignTemplateMetadata(currentTpl) and binds templateId and templateVersion into startPayload, passing them directly to background START_CAMPAIGN.

R1_MANDATE_2_DEFAULT_TEMPLATE_DELETION_G.description: TemplateStore.deleteTemplate() and popup handleDeleteTemplate() enforce that default templates cannot be deleted; users must set another template as default first (eliminates templates_v2 / xpider_tpl split-brain).

R1_MANDATE_3_STORAGE_REJECTION_COMPLIANC.description: TemplateStore setStore(), saveTemplateRecord(), and setDefaultTemplate() inspect chrome.runtime.lastError and callback errors, properly rejecting on storage failure.

R1_MANDATE_4_ACTIVE_SUBMIT_LOCK_QUERY.description: Popup controllers (dispatchSelectiveReset, dispatchGlobalReset) invoke checkActiveSubmitLock() to authoritatively query background campaignState (GET_STATE) and chrome.storage.local (xpider_currentAttempt for SUBMIT_PENDING).

R1_MANDATE_5_ACTUAL_CONTROLLER_TESTING.description: test_phase2b_acceptance.js directly invokes all production controller functions exported by popup.js plus startCampaign(). All 18 suite tests pass.

R1_MANDATE_6_EXECUTABLE_REPO_LAYOUT.description: Repackaged evidence strictly preserves repository layout (send_message_backup/... and root regression test files) so all test commands run directly upon extraction.

COMPONENT_A_TEMPLATE_MANAGER.storage_sync: Dual-accessor FormTemplateV2 canonical schema in templates_v2; synchronized to xpider_tpl on default change.
